name: Lifecycle State
notes: Primary reset stopped cranking running keyoff shutdown state

name: REF Raw Event Count
notes: Observed hardware reference edges before acceptance screening

name: REF Accepted Event Count
notes: Edges accepted as real reference events

name: REF Period
notes: Measured interval between accepted REF edges

name: REF Age
notes: Time since last accepted reference event

name: Engine Speed
notes: Derived from REF period and configured events per crank revolution

name: REF Events per Crank Revolution
notes: Editable setup echoed in live data

name: REF Events per Engine Cycle
notes: Two times REF events per crank revolution

name: REF Event Spacing
notes: 360 divided by REF events per crank revolution

name: REF to Event TDC Offset
notes: Signed setup phase applied before desired spark advance

name: REF Events per Combustion Event
notes: Reference event-cycle count divided by cylinder count

name: MAP Pressure Control
notes: Filtered MAP used by normal control logic

name: MAP Fault Reason
notes: Reason for invalid state if any

name: Barometric Pressure
notes: Captured from valid filtered MAP before rotation and held for run cycle

name: BARO Valid
notes: False if pre-rotation MAP capture was not valid

name: MAP to BARO Ratio
notes: Filtered MAP divided by captured BARO

name: Throttle Position Control
notes: Filtered throttle position used by control logic

name: Throttle Rate
notes: Dedicated filtered rate used by hybrid air model and AE

name: TPS Fault Reason
notes: Reason for invalid state if any

name: MAT Temperature Filtered
notes: Filtered measured temperature while sensor valid

name: MAT Control Temperature Absolute
notes: Absolute control temperature used by air-charge model

name: MAT Fault Reason
notes: Reason for invalid state if any

name: CTS Fault Reason
notes: Reason for invalid state if any

name: Battery ADC Input Voltage
notes: Voltage seen at PCM ADC input

name: Battery Voltage Control
notes: Filtered supply voltage used for normal calculations

name: Speed Density VE
notes: Interpolated VE used in SD estimate

name: Alpha-N Tip-In Request
notes: Authority request from positive TPS rate

name: Alpha-N Tip-Out Request
notes: Authority request from negative TPS rate

name: Air Mass per Cylinder
notes: Final air mass divided by configured cylinder count

name: Air Model Mode
notes: SD hybrid Alpha-N fallback or invalid
